name: 3S Farmer
author: Joakim
description: Area farming bot: patrols the explored rooms of the area you stand in and fights what the server lists there. Its fence is its own room graph, built from Room.Info - a room joins it only when you stand in it - so exploring first (or the mapper's handover of the area, 'map.query.area') is the workflow. One step per confirmed arrival, verified by room number; a step that lands elsewhere, an arrival nothing ordered, a move you typed, or a step that never lands stops the patrol, and it never resumes on its own. The target list IS the Room.Contents feed (no mob files): any monster not excluded here, not the party's and not on the never-list is attacked by the plain words of its name from the end, rotated on 'There is no X here'; a player in the room means hands off everything. Kill timing reads Char.Combat with a shelf life; a breath after each killing blow lets your looting triggers go first ('farm after <cmd>' sends one of yours), then the refreshed roster says what is left. Room.Map, the line-of-sight grid, steers the patrol toward rooms with monsters in sight and away from rooms with players. Floors: 'farm hp <start%> [<panic%>]' - no new fight or step under start%, the fight abandoned under panic% with 'farm panic <cmd>' sent once; 'farm rest <seid> <secs>' for Seid. 'farm go <area>' asks the mapper to walk you there and starts on arrival. Excludes: click a mob on the panel's roster (per area), or right-click it for the never-list that guild followers go on; 'farm exclude|include|excludes|never' are the typed forms. A patrol that stands still says why - on the panel's Waiting row, in 'farm', and once in the output. Kills are logged and tallied patrol or no patrol (1.4.2) - yours and your party's: every '<who> dealt the killing blow to <mob>' the server reports fills the kill log and the panel's Tally row, which counts per killer; only a fight the patrol opened moves its own counters, times the fight, and runs the after-kill chain. 1.5.0 (23 Sep): the kill log is kept per place - the area, and its floor when the room's name gives one (Megacity floor 30 and floor 40 are two logs); the panel shows the place you stand in, 'farm log all' every place, 'farm log clear here' one place - and its Last column became XP, what the last kill of each mob was worth (Char.XP over the fight). Also an XP row from GMCP Char.XP - the server's XP/hour and last-30-minute gain, the run's XP gain (frozen at the stop) and XP per kill, in 'farm' too; a crowded room's paged Room.Contents is read whole, and a monster's count is kept. 1.4.3 (23 Sep): GMCP Room.Death reports kills too; a kill's text line and its Room.Death are paired into one kill, whichever arrives first, and the pairing learns your character's name (kept per character), so a Room.Death alone counts as yours; a player's death (npc 0) is not a kill; your hird's kills (killer 'Hirdmadr') count as yours, and 'farm mine <name>' edits that list. The panel is three tabs (1.4.1): Patrol (status, buttons, gauges, roster, counters, kill log), Mobs (never / party / excludes / prefer / always), Settings (the after-kill chain and no-loot, rotation, the settings boxes, room rules). 1.4.0 (20 Sep): 'farm prefer <name>' sets the fight order per area (the preferred mob dies first when several stand together), 'farm always <name>' fights a mob even with a stranger in the room, 'farm rota add <area> / on' farms areas in turn - after a full circuit with no kill for the idle time the mapper is asked for a walk to the next one - and the settings (pace, hp, sp, rest, limit, panic) are boxes on the panel. 1.3.0 (20 Sep): 'farm after' is a chain - commands sent in order after each kill ('farm after add|del', the panel's table and box) - and 'farm noloot <name>' keeps a mob's corpse out of it per area; 'farm limit 45m|2h|50k' ends the run between fights, parking at the rest room when there is one, and tells your phone. 1.2.0 (20 Sep): a kill log on the panel (per mob: kills, average fight, last kill; 'farm log', 'farm log clear'), a rest room ('farm room <n> rest', or the map's right-click) the patrol walks to before resting and never fights in, the panic floor retreating there instead of stopping when one exists, an SP floor ('farm sp'), a resume bar for rests ('farm hp <start> <panic> <resume>'), and the leg being walked published for the map to light. Promoted from the lab at 1.0.0 (16 Sep 2026): docs/Plan-Map-Farmer.md phases 2-4 and Plan-Map-Farmer-Round2.md phases A-B.
